observedFailure: Before this patch, after applying the PR unit-header change, unitless R12 exports were rejected during LAYER table emission: the adapter passed layer 0 width enum 17 while this libdxfrw writer refuses non-default layer widths for R12/R14.

The existing unit test covers unitless, inches, millimetres and metres across R12/R14, with units loss reported where applicable.

Source-release inventory generation and check pass for 1244 files; 18-control inventory self-test passes. No drawing fixture was added.
limits: Only focused macOS static installed-codec behavior was tested. Default layer-width origin can be ambiguous, and bool-only save remains false for a reported conversion even though output exists. GUI behavior, native Linux/Windows, pinned/bundled codec, upstream integration, non-default widths beyond tested values, and full format support remain open.
